aggregation.objects: per recording: median F over boxes, share of boxes with n_rec = 0, median centroid_px over the boxes with n_rec > 0; then medians over recordings
aggregation.motion: per recording: median error over squares where both sets have events, share of squares where the scheme has no event (error NaN); then medians over recordings
aggregation.bits: per recording: bits of the scheme over the four windows of each group per true event, summed over groups; then medians over recordings
aggregation.st_us: per recording: median over its groups
